boundary.in_scope: Educational assessment and evaluation classified along four orthogonal axes: purpose (formative / summative / diagnostic), score interpretation (norm-referenced / criterion-referenced / ipsative), formality (formal / informal), and format (written / oral / performance-based); the measurement-quality properties validity (and its types: content, criterion, concurrent, predictive, construct, face) and reliability (and its types: test-retest, internal consistency, inter-rater, parallel-forms); the relations of an assessment to the learning outcomes it measures and is aligned with (measures, isAlignedWith / constructive alignment); and the assessment components rubric, item, and feedback together with their participants (learner) and outputs (assessment result).
boundary.out_of_scope: Curriculum structure (except the alignment link to learning outcomes); branded or named standardized exams (e.g. PISA, SAT, NAEP); education policy and administration; and statistical theory beyond validity and reliability.
